## Open limitation

The remaining templates render through the typed layout-family engine: their page geometry is structurally
distinct and covered by the 100-template distinctness gate, but they are **not** claimed as legacy parity.
Requirement R-51 therefore stays PARTIAL in the acceptance matrix until each remaining template has its own
restoration evidence.
